page.overview:
Who is The Jackal?

The Jackal was a ghola appointed by the Bene Tleilax to locate the Fremen.

The Jackal was sent to Arrakis to find the Fremen. He became an ally of them, but over time he learned that the Bene Tleilax did not value him or anyone else that they had assigned to locate the Fremen, only about their planned betrothal of Ariste Atreides and Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen.

The Jackal was approached by the Prisoner in an abandoned alleyway in Arrakis. Having visited the Wolf and the Vulture and solved their riddles, they told him they were seeking the footsteps of the worm. He told them that the words were sacred to the Fremen, who would speak them on the hajj in search of their umma. He concluded that they were close to their umma, which signified that they were there to kill him. They admitted that Count Hasimir Fenring had promised them information in exchange for completing the task. He told them that Fenring had been hunting them since Carthag and that many others had been sent before them to seek the Fremen. He urged them to complete the task and seek their answers. He then spoke of how they had all been cast aside and forgotten, telling them that they could complete the mission unless Fenring killed them first. They then strangled him to death with a garotte.
